draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.82, the 222nd-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 26th of 29 at CB. He lasted until pick 256, well after his grade rank (222nd): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 5 passes defended in 2024, 16th of 29 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Cincinnati Bengals (practice squad). 16 career games and 2 starts over 1 completed season. Still developing: 1 AV in 2025. Strengths in 2025: completion % allowed 50.0% (93rd percentile), missed tackle rate 4.2% (90th percentile). Weak spots: approximate value 1 (17th percentile). Versus the typical Year-1 cornerback who played: 22.4% season snap share against a median of 27.6%, below the norm.
